editorial_thesis: The durable advantage is shifting from raw agent capability to enforceable boundaries, sovereign deployment choices, selective memory deletion, and measurable delivery systems.

topic_groups.title: Agent Safety at the Runtime Boundary
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Treat the agent runtime as a security boundary, not a trusted process.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform
sources.why_selected: Prompt-level safety can be bypassed by a tool, credential, or network. NVIDIA is making the boundary a stack-level concern.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the split: in-process policy plus an independent observer. Buildn can expose traceable tool scopes and a kill switch without adopting NVIDIA hardware.

sources.title: OpenShell as the portable seam
sources.why_selected: A portable boundary is more reusable than a model-specific safety prompt.
sources.usefulness: Compare its primitives with Docker, microVMs, SSH sandboxes, and Hermes terminal environments.

sources.title: Anthropic cyber-evaluation incident review
sources.why_selected: The failure was configuration and operational security—not an exotic model escape. Harness assumptions are part of the safety case.
sources.usefulness: Add environment truth checks, egress deny-by-default, canary endpoints, and partner attestation to client evaluations.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot local sandboxing + OTel
sources.why_selected: This packages two operator needs—capability restriction and evidence—into a developer-facing surface.
sources.usefulness: Use as a benchmark for Buildn’s agent run UI: show scopes, spans, approvals, and rewinds.

sources.title: CWE-bench defensive evaluation
sources.why_selected: A secure patch that breaks behavior is not a successful delivery.
sources.usefulness: Turn this into a client readiness metric: exploit blocked, tests preserved, evidence attached.

topic_groups.title: Sovereign and Self-Hosted Agent Infrastructure
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Bring the agent to the data, then make every external connection explicit.

sources.title: IBM Bob self-hosted deployment
sources.why_selected: Sovereignty is becoming a deployment mode, not a compliance footnote.
sources.usefulness: Frame a Buildn/client offer around boundary mapping and deployment choice, not only prompt or model selection.

sources.title: OpenAI Private Intelligence
sources.why_selected: The market is trying to offer frontier capability without a simple “send everything to a public endpoint” posture.
sources.usefulness: Track the distinction between contractual privacy, technical confidentiality, and true local execution.

sources.title: Self-hosting AI models: privacy, control, cost
sources.why_selected: The practical question is whether the boundary benefit outweighs GPU, maintenance, and reliability costs.
sources.usefulness: Use its trade-offs to structure a Buildn infrastructure experiment and client TCO worksheet.

sources.title: NVIDIA OpenShell portability claim
sources.why_selected: The software/hardware split lets teams adopt a control concept without buying a full stack.
sources.usefulness: Separate portable policy and trace APIs from infrastructure-specific enforcement.

sources.title: Nebius + NVIDIA builder pathway
sources.why_selected: Some sovereignty and open-infrastructure ideas fail simply because experimentation lacks affordable compute.
sources.usefulness: Potential route for a Buildn evaluation or agent-runtime prototype needing GPU runway.

topic_groups.title: Memory Unlearning and Privacy
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A memory feature is incomplete until it can prove selective forgetting.

sources.title: Bemula: memory unlearning benchmark
sources.why_selected: Current memory systems often optimize write and retrieval, not deletion correctness.
sources.usefulness: A direct test plan for Buildn memory and any client knowledge assistant handling sensitive facts.

sources.title: Bemula benchmark code
sources.why_selected: A benchmark is more useful when it can become a regression test.
sources.usefulness: Adapt its data model for user facts, derived facts, preferences, and workflow memory.

sources.title: Memory Echo + MEchoBench
sources.why_selected: A memory can be confidently wrong because the system amplified its own prior output.
sources.usefulness: Store source-family IDs and correction state; distinguish evidence count from repetition count.

sources.title: Memorizing Who, Knowing How
sources.why_selected: Deleting a personal fact should not erase a reusable workflow, and a workflow should not silently become a user fact.
sources.usefulness: Split Buildn memory namespaces and permissions along this boundary.

sources.title: Reversible context curation
sources.why_selected: Not every context reduction should be permanent deletion; users need clear distinction between hide, forget, and archive.
sources.usefulness: Design three explicit operations in agent UI and logs.

topic_groups.title: Governed Agentic Delivery
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Make agentic delivery a system with budgets, review points, and recoverable artifacts.

sources.title: GitHub Agentic Engineering System
sources.why_selected: The unit of adoption shifts from assistant features to an engineered delivery system.
sources.usefulness: Use AES headings—knowledge, guardrails, observability, budgets, outcomes—as a Buildn/client assessment.

sources.title: Project HydraFusion routing trail
sources.why_selected: Routing by task risk and reviewability can outperform a single-model default at system level.
sources.usefulness: Prototype routing rules: low-risk draft, high-risk specialist, critic before commit.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex cloud + code review
sources.why_selected: Delegation becomes useful when environments, permissions, and artifacts survive the handoff.
sources.usefulness: Study the run lifecycle for Buildn’s long-running jobs and review packets.

sources.title: Microsoft Agent Framework release line
sources.why_selected: Portable primitives matter when clients need different model providers without rewriting workflow logic.
sources.usefulness: Compare its session and approval abstractions with Hermes’s conversation and tool loop.

sources.title: LightAgent v0.11.0
sources.why_selected: Long-running work needs resumability and artifact integrity more than another chat wrapper.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the primitives for scheduled research, report generation, and recoverable client jobs.
